footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes a $14.0M income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Jun 30, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 11.9% to $381M in fiscal 2026 (ended Jun 30, 2026). Gross margin was 26.9%, versus 27.6% a year earlier, and operating income rose 62.0% to $18.0M, a 4.7% margin.
Net income was $27.1M, or $1.86 per share, after a $697K loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $22.9M and free cash flow $9.2M, versus $8.8M; Twin Disc returned $2.3M through dividends.
watch: Net income includes a $14.0M tax benefit.
sources: Twin Disc, Incorporated Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)
